notes:
Quick, inbound SMB — self-serve signups. Customer profile: small support SaaS (helpbotics.ai) with a single customer-facing chat product. Wants to keep hosted API (no private infra).

Conversation highlights:
- Customer: "Users in EU feel chat sluggish compared to US; p95 spikes mid-day."
- They are on our free tier / early trial, ~50 agents hitting bot, average session ~600 tokens.
- Primary workload: short chat turn-taking + KB lookups; occasional reranking for suggested replies.

Observed pain & theory:
- Latency pattern: p50 ~350-450ms when routed to eu-west-1, p95 up to 1.6-2s during peak. US region p50 ~120-180ms.
- Likely drivers: region routing to nearest infra, but customer's client SDK default timeout=10s hides slow retries; no explicit region pinning in their integration. Prompt lengths show lots of system+history; median prompt size ~800 tokens (can be trimmed).

What we recommended on call (short actionable items):
- Pin region for critical low-latency traffic: test pointing to us-east-1 for US and eu-west-1 for EU, compare p50/p95 with identical synthetic script. (We offered a small test script.)
- Shorten client-side timeout and add exponential backoff with jitter for retries; set read timeout ~3s for interactive UX, 10s for background batch jobs.
- Trim context: keep system prompt concise, truncate long user history beyond 3 turns and store longer conversation in KB + retrieve relevant snippets instead of entire history. Aim for median prompt <=400 tokens for faster kernel paths.
- Use streaming for UI: show partial tokens to users at ~150ms increments to improve perceived latency even if p95 stays high.
- Try model variant with lower cost/latency (smaller quantized/open model) for non-critical routes; keep higher-capacity model for final answer/refinements.

Customer reaction & constraints:
- Dev lead: happy to test region pinning and prompt trimming but "we have only 1 engineer to run the perf script this sprint".
- Security: requires SSO and SOC2 evidence before moving to paid plan — they asked for SOC2 scan checklist (sent link).

- Week 1: Redwood sends perf-playbook + short test script for region comparison (Maya).
- Week 2: Helpbotics runs script and returns p50/p95 for us-east-1 vs eu-west-1; capture sample prompts (anonymized).
- Week 3: Redwood provides tuned SDK config suggestions (timeout/backoff) and sample prompt truncation helper; run a 100-concurrent-session smoke test (Redwood assistance available).
